full_page.content:
c. 1916 October
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 2
(cont'd. )
Pg. 35 so that when the time comes to depart this life we may go - each one in his turn not into ex- terior darkness -- but even more as a spouse than as a simple guest of Jesus. Our salvation is in our own hands. Almighty God has done His part - the Lord of lords and King of K's. He will never fail to do His part. One thing we must remember - we must keep our wedding gar- ment. To do this we must cooperate with the grace of God - use the means of grace given us. . Then we may be confident not only of escaping ... but ... the unspeakable joys where neither eye hath seen .
